caption: The drawing depicts a single beige-colored dress displayed on a headless, armless mannequin form, set against a gray background with a thin beige border. The dress features an off-the-shoulder neckline adorned with a delicate ruffle, and large, sheer, balloon sleeves decorated with white floral embroidery. The bodice is fitted with a cinched waist, leading to a full, floor-length skirt that is also embellished with detailed white floral patterns, arranged in horizontal bands around the garment. Two small decorative bows are attached at the junction of the sleeves and waistband. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller sketch in the same colors showing the back view of the dress, highlighting the continued fullness of the skirt and the design of the sleeves. The artist's name, "Jean Fessel," is written in small script at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Dress
